Paper.label: Paper
Paper.comment: A paper merged by its stable AI Index business identifier; response-specific values remain on PaperObservation.

Scholar.label: Scholar
Scholar.comment: A scholar merged by its stable AI Index business identifier; response-specific values remain on ScholarObservation.

Institution.label: Institution
Institution.comment: An institution merged by its stable AI Index business identifier; mutable metrics remain on InstitutionObservation.

Authorship.label: Authorship
Authorship.comment: An ordered, observation-scoped authorship membership reified from paper author_ids; authorOrder is array_index + 1 and isFirstAuthor is array_index == 0.

SourceDocument.label: SourceDocument
SourceDocument.comment: A complete replayable AI Index response document identified by workspace-relative source path and SHA-256.

contract.description: Fixed three-layer ontology template for AI Index paper, scholar, and institution search responses.
